thought: The current mainWorkflow expects folderId in the trigger input, which is not provided, causing a ValueError. We have an action_3 defined to search the folder 'ProAgentWorkspace' to get folderId, but its params are not set to search by folder name. Also, action_1 and action_2 have empty params, so they cannot run correctly. I will implement the params for action_3 to search by folder name 'ProAgentWorkspace' using searchMethod 'name'. Then implement action_1 with correct fileId param mode 'id' (not 'list'), and action_2 with Slack channel 'news' and text param. Finally, I will rewrite mainWorkflow to first call action_3 to get folderId, then proceed with the rest of the workflow.
plan: Implement action_3 params to search folder by name 'ProAgentWorkspace'
Implement action_1 params with fileId mode 'id' and value from input_data
Implement action_2 params to send Slack message to channel 'news' with text from input_data
